cta_keyword_he: מנשא, מנורה, רעש, כיסא, סינר, כוס, צלחת, כפית, כוס, קופסאות (one per product slide; ״כוס״ twice)
brand_presence: Logo and credentials top right on slides 1-12, the @Lotem_lerner handle bottom; the coupon code 'lotem' on slide 12; real photo and full logo on the closing slides
caption_summary: One-line caption: baby products she uses every day that make life easier, with a heart; no CTA in the caption
what_makes_it_work: One product per slide with three short benefits and its own comment keyword turns each slide into a separate low-effort lead, plus a coupon code for conversion. It got the lowest likes (100) in this set but strong comments (326), showing the keyword prompts drive comments over likes.
lumebook_takeaway: A 'products I actually use' list with one keyword per item is a monetisable format, but it is affiliate in tone, so LumeBook should use it only for a creator-collab or a gift-guide with one personal-link CTA.
